text:
Aisha Khan: Hi all — just accepted the org invite (aisha@redwood.com) but I can't access private repos I was told I'd need (model-zoo, infra-deploy). I only see public repos. :thinking:

infra-bot: Welcome Aisha! If you just accepted, team membership may not be applied yet. Check the org membership page at https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/people to confirm.

Aisha Khan: I checked and my account shows as a member, but not in any teams. Tried the 'Request access' button on the repo page and it says "Your request is pending" for model-zoo. Is there an expected delay?

Diego Ramos: Hey @Aisha welcome! People-ops typically adds new hires to default teams within a few minutes after SSO. If it's still pending, @Priya can you run the onboarding checklist?

Priya Singh: Hey Aisha — just pulled the onboarding queue. Looks like your invite completed but your account was matched to a different GitHub user (aishakhan-personal). That prevents automatic team assignment. Two quick options: 1) Add your work email to your personal GitHub account and verify it, then we can remap; or 2) people-ops can remove the conflicting pending account and reissue an invite explicitly to aisha@redwood.com. Which do you prefer?

Aisha Khan: I'd rather not touch my personal account. Please reissue to the work email.

people-ops: Will do. Re-sending invite to aisha@redwood.com now and marking for SSO + enforced team mapping. Accept when you get it and let us know.

Aisha Khan: Accepted the new invite. SSO flow completed. Still no teams, though — repo request for model-zoo still pending.

Diego Ramos: On it. @Priya can you add Aisha to teams: ml-engineering, infra? That should grant model-zoo and infra-deploy access. Also check branch protection and required teams.

Priya Singh: Added Aisha to ml-engineering and infra. You should now see model-zoo and infra-deploy in your repo list. If you still can't clone over SSH, check your SSH keys in https://github.com/settings/ssh/new.

Aisha Khan: I can view both repos now, thank you!! Quick question — when I try to push a branch I get a 403 via HTTPS: "You\u2019t have permission to push to this repository." I can open PRs via the web UI though.

Diego Ramos: That usually means your local git remote is pointing to your personal account credentials cached by the credential helper. Run `git remote -v` to confirm origin URL. If using HTTPS, try `git credential-osxkeychain erase` (mac) or clear stored creds, then do a push and authenticate with your work account. Alternatively switching to SSH avoids that.

Aisha Khan: Switched remote to SSH and added my work SSH key, push works now. One last thing — are there any onboarding repos or docs I should read that explain repo naming and team ownership?

Priya Singh: Yes — check the repo 'handbook/onboarding' and the TEAM_OWNERS.md in each repo. Also ping #eng to be added to the internal oncall rotation docs if you need deeper infra access.

Aisha Khan: Awesome, thanks everyone :tada:

infra-bot: If access irregularities persist, open a ticket in #help with screenshots and your GitHub username. Happy to help!
